notes: basePriceByRoof is the official retail price for that size + roof material.

options.* are ADD-ONS layered on the base price; fill any TODO (null) values.

meta.priceBasis: Original 12 retail catalog rows preserved; added footprints use the detailed 2026 workbook roof totals as written, approved September 18.

decorativeTrussPlates.label: Decorative Truss Plates
decorativeTrussPlates.note: Standard/in-base for 20'-wide+. Upgrade for narrower sizes (see size.decorativeTrussPlates).

height.label: Height
height.note: Base height varies by size (basePostFt). Heights below a size's base post length are not offered.

overhangFaceboard.label: Overhang Faceboard
overhangFaceboard.note: Price = faceboardLinearFt * retailRatePerLF * (1+markup). Per-size $ in size.overhangFaceboard.

rafterTail.label: Rafters
rafterTail.note: Scroll Cut = $50 x (rafters + trusses). Per-size $ in size.rafterTailUpgrade.

texturedMetal.label: Textured Metal
texturedMetal.note: +8% of the selected roof's roofing-package cost (size.roofingCost). Per-size $ in size.texturedMetalUpcharge.

timberFinish.appliesTo: Structural timbers (posts, girders, ridge, rafters, collar ties, truss members). Excludes hardware, T&G roof decking, faceboards, and angle braces by default — adjust FINISH_SCOPE.

price._confirm: Proposed = 'Resaw for looks' $0.35/BF — confirm rate & basis

timberFinish.label: Timber Finish

trussStyle.label: Truss Style
trussStyle.note: Upgrade = $200 x truss count. size.trusses holds the count; per-size $ in size.trussStyleUpgrade.
